title: Instant-Issue Card Kit Price List — Paystride Payroll Card Program
content:
## Kit and shipping prices

Instant-issue card kits for the Paystride Payroll Card Program are priced per kit, with a shipping fee per kit order. Each package also states the kits supplied without kit fee with the launch order, and the kits per calendar month supplied without kit fee while the employer's Earned Wage Access program is live.

| Package | Kit fee per kit (USD) | Kits without kit fee with the launch order | Kits per calendar month without kit fee while Earned Wage Access is live | Standard shipping per kit order (USD) | Expedited shipping per kit order, instead of standard (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Paystride Paycard Program Essential | 3.50 | 0 | 25 | 12.50 | 45.00 |
| Paystride Paycard Program Standard | 3.00 | 25 | 25 | 12.50 | 45.00 |
| Paystride Paycard Program Select | 2.50 | 50 | 50 | 10.00 | 40.00 |
| Paystride Paycard Program Advantage | 2.00 | 100 | 50 | 10.00 | 35.00 |
| Paystride Paycard Program Premier | 1.50 | 250 | 100 | 0.00 | 30.00 |
| Paystride Paycard Program Elite | 0.00 | 500 | 200 | 0.00 | 25.00 |

### Notes

- Expedited shipping is charged in place of standard shipping on an order shipped expedited; an order never carries both.
- The Premier and Elite packages carry no standard shipping fee, and the Elite package carries no kit fee.
- The Essential package supplies no kits without kit fee with its launch order.

### Hypothetical price check

A hypothetical Select package employer, with no kits supplied without fee on the order, orders 125 kits by standard shipping: the kits are priced at 2.50 each, 312.50 in all, and the order carries one standard shipping fee of 10.00. Shipped expedited, the same order carries 40.00 of expedited shipping instead of the 10.00.
